source.label: PSNProfiles: Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (synced from PSN)
source.note: PS5 list, checked Nov 18, 2026. Names and descriptions as shown on PSN.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: A dozen trophies are tied to the story: one per chapter, one for the final mission and several for named missions. Story choices also count toward Actions Speak Louder as you go, so play normally.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side people
roadmap.text: Finish 8 stranger mission strands for Strangers & Freaks. Several strands have a hidden trophy of their own for the last mission. Beat Cal in a fishing challenge while you are at it.

roadmap.title: Sweep Leonida
roadmap.text: Explore all 52 areas, meditate at all 18 spots, WAiNK It at 100 locations, finish 3 card sets and discover 100 vehicles. Work region by region and pick up drone races (14 locations), shooting range golds (42) and stunts (250) on the way.

roadmap.title: Crime and money
roadmap.text: Rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store unseen and an illegal operation from each gang (9). Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills, spend $100,000 in shops, buy all 8 garages and register 10 cars with Scooter Bros.

roadmap.title: Finish the 100% checklist
roadmap.text: The 100% checklist only shows up after the credits roll. Work through it with our [100% checklist](/guides/100-percent-checklist/). A Long Road unlocks the platinum.

items.name: Vice Got a Price!
items.how: Earn every other trophy. There are no online trophies, so it is all single player.

items.name: Just Like Paradise
items.how: Unlocks when you finish the first mission as Jason.

items.name: Paradise Lost
items.how: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It cannot be missed.

items.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
items.how: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2.

items.name: Vice City, Baby!
items.how: Story trophy for Chapter 3. It pops at the start of Chapter 4, once Ocean Beach and Another Life are done.

items.name: Top Of The World, Ma
items.how: Unlocks at the end of Starting From Zero, the last Chapter 4 mission.

items.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
items.how: Story trophy for the last mission of the game.

items.name: Trust
items.how: Story mission in Chapter 2.

items.name: Break the Bank
items.how: Finish the heist that closes Chapter 3. It pays $120,000.

items.name: Family Matters
items.how: Story mission in Chapter 4: rescue Rafa with Andrés. Can't be missed; the game makes you play it before Power Play.

items.name: DWNFALL
items.how: Dre'Quan's launch party, the last setup job before the Chapter 4 heist.

items.name: Hi-Jacked
items.how: The big Chapter 4 heist.

items.name: Snow Storm
items.how: Story mission in Chapter 5.

items.name: A Long Road
items.how: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist. It only appears after the credits, and it has 35 items. Every other trophy on this list helps along the way.

items.name: Cunning Stunts
items.how: You need 250 stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there. Stunt jumps count, and 50 of them also unlock the unlimited nitrous cheat.

items.name: Master of None
items.desc: Try each type of activity once.
items.how: There are 9 activity types. Try each once: the activities guide lists the ones that count toward 100%, like pool, mini golf, basketball, races, shooting ranges, fishing and video games.

items.name: The Shootist
items.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
items.how: Gold in every shooting range challenge, 42 medals in all. The 100% checklist needs the same 42.

items.name: Top Fun
items.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
items.how: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. The 100% checklist goes further and counts 42 drone time trials.

items.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
items.how: Win 20 different races; repeating one does not help. Venues include Gellhorn Raceway, the Thrillbilly Mud Club and Boone Speedway. The 100% checklist wants 30.

items.name: Baited My Tackle
items.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
items.how: After Feng Shui in Chapter 1, Cal texts Jason a challenge: take a boat out to his spot in Gambit Bay, drop anchor and fish with the Small Saltwater Lure until you land a stoplight parrotfish over 2 lbs, then send it to him.

items.name: Stick Fiddler
items.how: Finish one of the four in-game video games. Three are on the console at Jason's house; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade cabinets.

items.name: Road to Rehabilitation
items.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
items.how: Finish Andy's five Cellerica jobs as Lucia in Chapter 3. The last one is Puff Puff Pass.

items.name: This Was No Boat Accident
items.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
items.how: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand. It starts with Island Dreams in Chapter 1.

items.name: The Lone Rider
items.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
items.how: Finish Billy's five jobs. The last one, Hometown Heroes in Chapter 3, needs both Jason and Lucia.

items.name: Strangers & Freaks
items.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
items.how: Finish 8 stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; not every contact does, so check the trophy tracker after each final mission.

items.name: Supply & Demand
items.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
items.how: Finish Randy's car strand. It starts in Chapter 3 with the Zorrusso job, which also gets you the key cloner.

items.name: Spin On This!
items.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
items.how: Destroy Kitty Litter labs for Tyrone until he gives you his last job, Spin On This, at a diner outside Grayson in Lummox County, then finish it. The labs start in Chapter 3.

items.name: Positive Mental Attitude
items.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
items.how: Meditate at all 18 spots. The 100% checklist only needs 15. Unconfirmed: one guide reports that a meditation Lucia offers at Jason's house in Chapter 1 may count and may not come back, so accept it if she asks.

items.name: Fair Game
items.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
items.how: Bret, the hunting contact, asks for a unique animal. Hunt it for him.

items.name: Don't Touch My Deck
items.how: Complete 3 card sets. The 100% checklist needs 15.

items.name: You WAiNKer!
items.how: Scan landmarks, statues and art with the WAiNK phone app at 100 locations. The 100% checklist needs the same 100.

items.name: One Last Thing
items.how: Challenges come in eight categories, from Combat to Vehicle. All 80 are open from the start. You need 50; the 100% checklist wants 70.

items.name: Hot Together
items.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
items.how: Both leads have to be together (you can text or call your partner from the phone). Reach four stars, then get away. To shake the police, change what they are looking for: clothes, car or the way you look.

items.name: Retail Therapy
items.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
items.how: Team up with your partner and rob three shops in a row without letting the wanted level drop.

items.name: Whip It Good
items.how: Scanning a car with WAiNK counts as discovering it; you don't have to drive it. Hold D-Pad Up to open WAiNK fast, then R1/RB to scan; boats and aircraft count too. The 100% checklist wants 200 base models.

items.name: Gunslinger
items.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
items.how: Combat Focus slows time while you aim (L3 and R3 together). Line up five takedowns before it runs out.

items.name: Catch Me If You Can
items.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
items.how: Steal one of the big passenger jets parked at a boarding bridge at VCIA; planes standing out on the airfield don't count. The jet at gates E3/E4 is the easiest: drive through the airfield fence, take the stairs beside the bridge, get into the cockpit, reverse onto the runway and take off. It pops once you are roughly a kilometre from the airport.

items.name: Challenging Tank
items.how: Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island base at the far south-west of Mariana County. Get in through the gate (or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and shoot a few soldiers until it pops.

items.name: Sneakthief
items.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
items.how: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. Jewelry stores are part of the Smash 'N' Grabs on the 100% checklist.

items.name: Maximum Withdrawal
items.how: Rob five large bank vaults and get away. The vaults open at the end of Chapter 4 with the optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank and go in while the vault is open. You get four stars at once, so leave on a fast bike and switch cars. The 100% checklist wants all 8.

items.name: A Classic Blitz Play
items.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
items.how: Rob an armored truck and escape.

items.name: The Goodtime State
items.how: Explore all of Leonida. PSN tracks it as 52 parts of the map, so fly or drive into every corner.

items.name: Pest Control
items.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
items.how: There are 9 gangs. Rob one illegal operation belonging to each. The 100% checklist wants 39 gang operations in total.

items.name: In The Beginning…
items.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
items.how: Buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and drink it while standing at the bar.

items.name: Capital Offense
items.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
items.how: Only the blue Banshee in the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City counts. You need the key cloner, so it opens up after Steal the Zorrusso for Randy in Chapter 3. Clone its key, drive straight out through the showroom window and keep going down the street: it pops a moment later.
items.linkLabel: How to get the key cloner

items.name: Let’s Go Bowling
items.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
items.how:
The bowling alley is **Kingpin Bowling** in Port Gellhorn, a Kolt & Associates hangout. Robbing it is a side job that opens after [Coffee Break](/walkthrough/coffee-break/) in Chapter 2.

The trophy wants all three valuables inside: a **luxury watch** in a room on the southeast side, the unique **Gutterball Moreland 850** shotgun in the northeast, and the **safe in the northeast office**, which you blow open with a sticky bomb. Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first, bring body armor and healing, and take your partner along.

Not missable: the job comes back later in the story if you leave something behind.

items.name: Personal Best
items.how: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time (check it under the touchpad menu, Jason & Lucia). Buy a gym membership and train together: while one works out, the other trains too, so it goes twice as fast. Possible once you can switch characters after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

items.name: Actions Speak Louder
items.how: PSN counts 500 choices that shape your criminal profile. They add up as you play.

items.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
items.how: A repeat of the Prologue robbery. Once Credit Check in Chapter 3 has opened payday loans, go back to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba as Lucia, on her own, and rob it again, then get away on foot rather than in a vehicle. It pops a little while after you have slipped out of the police search area. Not missable.

items.name: The Truth Is Out There
items.how: Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 AM. Look for a car with blinking lights at the roadside (it is random: drive off and come back if it isn't there), follow the path into the woods to the blue light, then help the woman who is dropped off and take her back to her car.

items.name: Ten Pin
items.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
items.how: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds (Square / X while riding). Busy streets in Vice City or along Ocean Beach make it quick.

items.name: Dime on the Dollar
items.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
items.how: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through fences. It is the same figure the 100% checklist asks for.

items.name: Treat Yo Self
items.how: Spending adds up across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos cost the most, so they get you to $100,000 fastest.

items.name: Little Boxes
items.how: Buy all 8 garage properties.

items.name: On the Spot
items.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
items.how: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.

faq.q: How many trophies does GTA 6 have?
faq.a: 55 on PS5: 1 platinum (**Vice Got a Price!**), 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze. 27 of them are hidden on PSN until you earn them.

faq.q: Are there online trophies in GTA 6?
faq.a: No. Every trophy is earned in single player, so the platinum doesn't need anyone else.

faq.q: Is there a trophy for 100% completion?
faq.a: Yes, **A Long Road** (gold). The 100% checklist only shows up after the credits roll; work through it with our [100% checklist](/guides/100-percent-checklist/) and [100% route](/guides/100-percent-route/).

faq.q: How many GTA 6 trophies come from the story?
faq.a: About a dozen: one for each chapter, one for the final mission and several for named missions. The rest are open-world and collectible trophies, which you can work on alongside the story.

faq.q: Can I track which trophies I've earned on this page?
faq.a: Yes. Tick a trophy and it stays ticked in your browser, with a progress bar at the top. Use **Not earned** to see only what's left.
